title: Teenager allegedly organised arsons and kidnapping on Signal during Melbourne hospitality wars
summary_full: Victoria police say boy, 17, communicated with offenders under username ‘Onepercent’Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcastVictorian police allege a 17-year-old boy tasked others to carry out a series of arsons, home invasions and a mistaken identity kidnapping that resulted in the partial amputation of a victim’s finger during Melbourne’s hospitality wars.The boy, who was arrested on Friday afternoon, allegedly communicated with the offenders under the username “Onepercent” on the encrypted communications app Signal.
